description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the "Number of Tokens" and an unlabeled metric for four different data sources: Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Tokens," uses a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40, and has tick marks at intervals of 10. The plot contains four solid lines, all featuring circular markers at specific data points corresponding to x=200, 500, 800, and 1000. The blue line, representing "Tutorials," begins at approximately 23 at x=200, rises to a peak of roughly 29 at x=800, and slightly declines to end at approximately 28.5 at x=1000. The red line, representing "Library Documentation," starts at roughly 26 at x=200, increases to a peak of approximately 32 at x=800, and then decreases to end at roughly 27 at x=1000. The yellow line, representing "StackOverflow posts," begins at its highest point of approximately 33 at x=200 and exhibits a steady decline across the x-axis, passing through approximately 30.5 at x=500 and 19 at x=800, before ending at roughly 11.5 at x=1000. The green line, representing "Github files," starts at approximately 28 at x=200, rises to a peak of roughly 33 at x=800, and declines to end at approximately 30 at x=1000.
